sources.fullCitation: Jan Kiepura with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Dr. Weissmann. “Ninon”, the song from the sound film Ein Lied für dich; music by Walter Jurmann and Dr. Bronislaw Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter and Ernst Marischka.
